concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-in-person-guides-card-data-collection]] - 2026-09-16 unversioned Braintree In-Person website guide for online reader collection of raw track data from non-PCI, ISO 7813 magstripe cards under configured merchant BIN ranges, with caller-owned issuer handling and result display plus time-limited, delete-after-first-successful-retrieval context data; collection or context completion is not authorization, vaulting, transaction processing, payment outcome, consent, secure downstream handling, or current account and reader eligibility proof
